scientific_integrity: The infinite-class statement rests on a proved conditional-drift identity and finite-chain absorption, not numerical extrapolation. Literature comparisons have residual risk of unindexed equivalent formulations.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected incidence-regular hypergraphs, all edges size >=3; model-1 full-edge copying, fixed fitness; excludes majority updates, irregular degrees, time dependence and quantitative gap optimization.
title: Strict Moran suppression for every regular higher-order replacement hypergraph
